name: geneva-tax-advisor
description: Guide taxpayers through filing Geneva (Switzerland) tax returns with GeTax. Covers salary, professional expenses (forfaitaire vs effectifs), pillar 3a/3b, health insurance, medical expenses, securities (DA-1/RSI), foreign property, bank accounts, debts, crypto, and dual-income couples. Use when filing via GeTax, optimizing ICC/IFD deductions, declaring foreign property or income, handling DA-1 reclaims, or navigating Geneva cantonal tax rules.
